auth.welcomeSubtitle: Find your place, or list one — sign up with your phone number
auth.enterCode: Enter the code sent to your phone
auth.disclaimer: By continuing you agree to Koreb Homes' Terms & Privacy Policy.
auth.brandHeadline: Find your place, or list one.
auth.brandStory: Ethiopia's premium property marketplace — verified agents, real photos, and a straightforward path from search to signed deal.
auth.googleSoonHint: Google sign-in is coming shortly. For now, continue with your phone number.

listingDetail.messagingSoon: In-app messaging arrives in a later update. For now, use Call or WhatsApp.
listingDetail.contactUnavailable: This lister hasn't shared a contact number yet.
listingDetail.reportThanks: Thank you — our team will review this listing.
listingDetail.signInToReport: Please sign in to report a listing.
listingDetail.notFoundBody: This listing may have been removed or is no longer available.

postListing.photosHint: Photos are compressed automatically for fast loading on any connection.
postListing.verificationRequiredBody: Koreb Homes requires ID verification before your first listing goes live. This step is coming soon via Fayda, Ethiopia's national digital ID.
postListing.title: Post a Listing
postListing.buildingNameHint: e.g. Zefmesh Grand — helps buyers find named developments
postListing.unitPrivateNote: Not shown publicly. Only you and our review team can see this — it helps us prevent duplicate and fraudulent listings.
postListing.unitRequiredApt: Unit number is required for apartments.
postListing.pinLocation: Pin the location on the map
postListing.pinHint: Drag the pin to the exact spot. This helps buyers find it and powers map search.
postListing.tapToSetPin: Tap the map to drop a pin
postListing.descriptionHint: Describe what makes this place special. Both languages are optional but recommended.
postListing.photoHint: Photos are compressed automatically for fast loading on any connection. The first photo is your cover.
postListing.feeFreeBody: Koreb Homes is free to list on during our launch period. No payment needed.
postListing.reviewNote: Every listing is checked by our team before going live — usually within a day.
postListing.submittedBody: Your listing is now with our team for review. You’ll see it on your dashboard, and it goes live once approved — usually within a day.
postListing.verifyRequiredBody: Koreb Homes requires a one-time identity check with Fayda (Ethiopia’s national digital ID) before your first listing goes live. This keeps the marketplace trustworthy for everyone.
postListing.verifyComingSoon: Fayda verification is coming soon. For now you can prepare your listing and it will be saved.
postListing.mustBeOwnerBody: Only owners and agents can post listings. You’re signed in as a buyer/renter. Contact support to change your account type.
postListing.signInToPost: Please sign in to post a listing.
postListing.missingRequired: Please fill in all required fields before continuing.
postListing.updatedBody: Your edits have been saved and the listing is back in review. It goes live again once an admin approves it — usually within a day.
postListing.editReviewNote: Editing sends this listing back for review before it goes live again.

admin.nothingToReview: Nothing waiting for review right now.
admin.queueEmpty: The review queue is empty — all caught up.
admin.rejectNotePlaceholder: e.g. Same unit as listing posted 3 days ago.
admin.listingFeeEnabledHint: When on, owners pay before a listing is reviewed. Off during the free launch period.
admin.listingFeeAmountHint: Charged per listing when fees are on.
admin.accessDeniedBody: This area is restricted to platform administrators.

dashboard.title: My Listings
dashboard.subtitle: Manage everything you've posted
dashboard.reviewNote: An admin is reviewing this listing. It usually goes live within a day.
dashboard.unpublishedNote: This listing was unpublished for inactivity. Renew it to make it live again.
dashboard.awaitingPaymentNote: Finish payment to send this listing for review.
dashboard.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently removes the listing and its photos. This can't be undone.
dashboard.emptyBody: When you post a property, it'll show up here so you can track its status.
dashboard.emptyFilterBody: You have no listings with this status.
dashboard.notOwnerBody: Switch to an owner or agent account to post and manage listings.
dashboard.soldNote: This listing is marked sold. It stays visible with a badge — mark it available again if that changes.
dashboard.rentedNote: This listing is marked rented. It stays visible with a badge — mark it available again if that changes.
dashboard.billingBody: Agents currently pay the same flat fee per listing as individual owners. Subscription plans for unlimited listings arrive in Phase 2.

favorites.title: Saved Properties
favorites.subtitle: Listings you've favorited
favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on any listing to save it here for later.
favorites.signInTitle: Sign in to see your saved properties
favorites.signInBody: Your favorites are tied to your account.
